svg.title: TOPAK H3 — Verification map: what is checked, what is proved, what must fail, and what neither claims
svg.desc: Every check and proof in the corpus at G10. Three methods, three words (ADR-0046 §1, A1): TLC checks twenty-seven TLA+ modules at small constants, each mutation failing the property it targets and each reachability witness violated; the TLA+ Proof System proves the invariants of twenty-two of them, 5,225 obligations, under named assumptions and the absence of the mutations that break each; and nineteen of those proofs are certified, every SMT obligation backed by a proof an independent checker accepted (H6). Then the policy floor's gates, run on the genesis floor and on the three stages of the proposed floor the reference now links; the reference's 133 tests restating the properties; the trace harness that replays those tests through an operational model, current with the tree, which found a race no proof could; the drift pins; and the lineage gate suite. Then the honesty layer: a proof is of the module, a certified proof is not a verified one, and what runs is neither checked nor proved. Beside them, proposed and cited by no record yet, a second route in Lean (ADR-0053; H7): thirteen proof modules' theorems proved again of re-encodings, the admit decision proved a step of FloorComposition and the clock check of transcriptions of the Rust, and the genesis floor's totality under Cedar's verified model.

text.tspan: Drift: records and modules pinned by the reference
: what it checks, what must fail, what is proved and certified, and where its result is

svg.text: Twenty-seven modules and twenty-two proof modules (G10 §2.9, §9: G9's twenty and fifteen, with Labels, ToolList, Operators, Emergency, Correlator, BreakGlass_A1 and NonComposition_A1, and seven proofs). Properties are invariants checked under Mut = "none"; each mutation changes the mechanism, never the property, and must produce a counterexample; each Never… witness must be violated, which shows the behaviour it names is reachable. The proof column gives each

proof module, its obligations (ADR-0046 §4) and whether its certified run certifies (A1; H6); its results files are <Module>-proof-results-<date>.txt and <Module>-proof-cert-results-<date>.txt. Results files are dated and never change; every proof results file, and every module added since G9, regenerates from a script (G10 item 78, in part). Pinned means listed in mechanism/corpus-pins.sha256. The binding table has no rows yet for the six modules of G10 (item 90).

text.tspan: 5 · The honesty layer: what none of the above claims

svg.text: G7 said, as every checkpoint since G3 had: "no theorem is proved". G8 was the first checkpoint under which a property of the corpus is proved, in ADR-0046 §1's sense; G10 is the first at which a proof can be certified (ADR-0046 A1), and it says in the same breath that a certified proof is not a verified one (G10 §8).
Proved names a claim TLAPS discharged and the hypotheses it was discharged under: twenty-two modules' invariants. Certified names a proof whose every
obligation is closed by the prover's normalization, a checked proof or LS4: nineteen of them. Checked names TLC's evidence: the mutations and witnesses at
small constants. None is used of the running reference (ADR-0046 §1, A1). A fourth, proposed: proved in Lean, of an encoding, a transcription or a statement,
Trace validation is drift detection against a model of the code: tested paths only, and it cannot check ContainedMeansConfined; a checked gate proof certifies
an implication between two Cedar encodings, not the encoding (G8 §8). The theorem-to-premise table says what each property assumed.

text.tspan: Small constants; the prover as written

svg.text: "A property that holds at two principals and one epoch is evidence, not a proof" (T-0045-29, G5 §8): since B25 that residual bounds the mutations and witnesses
only. Model checking at practical constants: none yet (spec/README.md practice item 3; G10 §7, item 75 as at G9).
TLC and the prover are trust-root rows (T-0045-29, T-0045-31), trusted as written: no mutation of either is run. A certified proof still trusts the prover's
translation of an obligation into a query, its normalization, LS4, and the checker (G10 §3); three modules certify on nothing more than the prover as first
"Five records, twenty-eight amendments, six modules and their proofs, a rebuilt reference and the model it is checked against are one hand's, drafted, built,
checked and ratified across three days with no second reader" (G10 §4). The certification wrapper, its driver and every result are the drafter's (B28).
The operational model was written from the code by the same hand: "a model written from the code by the same hand agrees with the code" (ToO §11.3).
Breaking it on purpose, one modelled thing at a time, is the check that it can disagree (A14; G10 §5).

text.tspan: What runs is neither checked nor proved

svg.text: "Twenty-two modules' invariants are proved, nineteen with checked proofs, and nothing about the running reference is. A matching trace is drift detection on
tested paths; T-0045-28 stands" (G10 §8). "What runs is not the specification" (ADR-0045 §5, R1): no refinement from the modules to the Rust exists and the
build is asserted, not reproduced: trust-root rows T-0045-28 to 30, for every deployment.
Operators.tla and Emergency.tla are tied to the reference by tests and no refinement (item 90).

text.tspan: What the checks do not cover

svg.text: A holds° is cedar's own term folding with no query to check: in the emergency stage's run, all 41 totality checks rest on the engine's row (T-0045-3), not the
checker's (G9 item 69). For those 41, and the genesis floor's 23, a Lean proof under cedar-spec's model is proposed (ADR-0053 R3).
The CPC signature is cvc5's own formalization, trusted as written (G7 §4). The race in lease expiry had no property to violate: the clock is outside every
module, and it was found because a test failed one run in three under tracing, "and no proof would have found it" (ADR-0033 A13). Whether anything else a
replica keeps is recorded after the lock is released was not audited (item 96).
Stage 1, trace validation: A5 (Batch 21), rerun at A6, widened at A7 and A8, not rerun at A10 to A12, and current with the tree again at A14; A15 changed
